title: On-prem offline bundle: include observability dashboards + Prometheus rules (minimum pack) and validate air-gapped install
creator: Connor O'Brien
description:
Private on-prem (air-gapped) installs require all observability artifacts to be shipped in the offline bundle, with no network access to fetch dashboards/rules at install time.

This ticket ensures:
- Grafana dashboards for the Private observability minimum pack are bundled (as JSON assets and/or pre-rendered ConfigMaps) in the offline artifact.
- Prometheus rules (alerting + recording rules) for the minimum pack are bundled and installed.
- Install/upgrade validation is performed in a no-egress environment.

Motivation: Support/SE feedback + internal staging showed the airgap bundle could install successfully but result in missing/empty dashboards due to artifacts not being included (or not being referenced by the bundle manifest).
acceptance_criteria:
- Offline bundle contains:
  - Grafana dashboards for minimum pack (runtime overview, control plane health, infra/gpu panels as included in the v1 catalog)
  - Prometheus alert rules + recording rules for minimum pack
  - Any required datasources/dashboards provisioning snippets that the installer expects
- Bundle manifest explicitly lists the above artifacts with stable paths, plus checksums/signatures as applicable.
- Air-gapped validation:
  - Perform install in an environment with outbound egress blocked
  - Verify Grafana shows Redwood dashboards after install
  - Verify Prometheus loads rules (no rule parse errors) and targets are scraped
  - Verify installer post-install validation catches missing artifacts (hard fail) rather than silently succeeding
- Document any required operator actions for customers (e.g., configuring storage class / PVC sizes) but do NOT require customers to fetch anything from the internet.
implementation_notes:
Implementation approach (aligned with installer packaging constraints):
- Treat dashboards + rules as first-class offline assets, versioned alongside the private installer release.
- Bundle builder now pulls from the same versioned observability-pack artifacts used in online installs, then writes them into the airgap tarball under a stable directory:
  - /artifacts/observability/dashboards/*.json
  - /artifacts/observability/prometheus-rules/*.yaml
- Bundle manifest includes explicit entries for these artifacts; bundle build fails if the expected set is incomplete.
- Installer wiring:
  - During install, installer loads the embedded artifacts and creates/updates ConfigMaps in the target namespace.
  - Post-install validation checks: Grafana API returns >=1 dashboard with the Redwood folder UID; Prometheus reports rules loaded with no errors.

Key PR: sources/github/redwood-private-installer/pr-18441-include-offline-observability-artifacts-in-airgap-bundle.json (bundle contents + manifest + installer wiring updates).
validation_plan:
Validation executed using the onprem-airgap validation plan (Drive: onprem-airgap-validation-plan.json).

Steps:
1) Build offline bundle from release branch with observability pack enabled.
2) Stand up a test cluster and block all outbound egress (NetworkPolicy + node-level egress deny).
3) Install using the offline bundle only (image mirror preloaded).
4) Confirm:
   - Grafana pods healthy; datasource provisioned
   - Dashboards present in UI and render panels after generating test traffic
   - Prometheus pods healthy; /rules endpoint shows minimum-pack groups loaded; no parse errors in logs
   - Installer post-install validation reports success
5) Upgrade/rollback sanity:
   - Upgrade to next build (same major) and ensure dashboards/rules remain present
   - Roll back and ensure dashboards/rules still present (no orphaned ConfigMaps / broken UIDs)

Results (2025-07-22): PASS in no-egress environment; dashboards + rules present after fresh install; upgrade maintained artifacts; rollback did not break provisioning.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risks:
- Drift between what Helm charts reference vs what the offline bundle contains (silent failures).
- Large dashboard JSON payloads increasing bundle size.
- Backward compatibility when dashboards or metric names change.

Mitigations:
- Bundle build now fails CI if required artifact globs are empty or checksums mismatch.
- Keep artifacts versioned by release; avoid dynamic fetch at runtime.
- Coordinate with ENG-19155 for any dashboard UID/path migrations and metric renames; installer validation checks are designed to catch missing resources early.

comments: 2025-06-10 (Connor O'Brien): Creating as P1/release-blocker. We’ve had at least one staging install succeed with zero dashboards in Grafana when using the airgap tarball. We need offline bundle parity with online installs for minimum-pack artifacts.

2025-06-12 (Fatima Noor): On-prem customers will assume “offline bundle” is fully self-contained. If we require fetching dashboards/rules from GitHub at install time it’s a non-starter. Please ensure the bundle has everything and the installer never tries external pulls.

2025-06-17 (Chloe Martin): Dashboards are currently generated via observability-pack build and referenced by Helm in online install. For offline, we should embed the compiled dashboard JSON outputs, not source templates, to reduce moving parts.

2025-06-24 (Diego Santos): Found root cause: airgap bundle manifest included Prometheus/Grafana images but not the observability-pack artifact directory. Installer path expects /artifacts/observability/* but bundle was missing that folder in the tarball. Implementing manifest enforcement + postinstall validation.

2025-07-03 (Sahana Iyer): Added an airgap CI job stub to validate bundle contents (tar listing + checksum check). Will follow up in ENG-19156 to run a full no-egress cluster smoke test, but we can at least prevent “missing dashboards” regressions at build time now.

2025-07-18 (Rafael Mendes): Please ensure the installer post-install checks fail loudly if dashboards/rules aren’t applied. Support can’t debug “empty Grafana” if install says success. Also add an explicit log line listing how many dashboards were installed.

2025-07-22 (Diego Santos): Validation complete in no-egress environment. Grafana shows 6 Redwood dashboards (minimum pack v1). Prometheus rules loaded (3 groups) and no rule parse errors. Installer logs now include 'installed_dashboards=6 installed_rule_groups=3'. Marking ready.

2025-07-25 (Connor O'Brien): Shipped on release branch and confirmed bundle build includes /artifacts/observability/. Closing as Done. Follow-ups: upgrade migrations (ENG-19155) + full E2E smoke harness (ENG-19156).
final_state: Done. Offline bundle now includes minimum-pack dashboards + Prometheus rules as explicit assets in the airgap tarball, enforced by the bundle manifest and validated post-install. Air-gapped install validated with outbound egress blocked; dashboards render and rules load successfully.
